schema.position_values: GK | DF | MF | FW (FIFA short form — will be normalized to api-football's Goalkeeper/Defender/Midfielder/Attacker on import)
schema.name: player full name as FIFA published it (with accents). Will be matched to api-football's short name during enrichment.
schema.club: club name (free text — for display only)
schema.api_player_id: leave null — filled by automated enrichment pass from api-football /players/squads on June 4-6

fill_instructions: For each team where FIFA has published the official 26-man roster:
1. Open the FIFA squad page (link in primary_source above)
2. Copy/paste each player into the players[] array of that team
4. Set announced_date to the date FIFA published it (YYYY-MM-DD)
5. Players who haven't been announced yet — leave team_status='pending', players=[] (empty array)
After all 48 teams are 'announced', run the enrichment script to fill api_player_id from api-football.
next_steps: Step 1 (June 2-3): fill this file from FIFA's official squad announcements
Step 2 (June 4-6): run a script that calls api-football /players/squads?team={api_team_id} for each team, fuzzy-matches names by lastname+team, fills api_player_id
Step 3 (June 7-10): re-pull to catch FIFA's allowed injury-replacement window
Step 4: apply final SQL upsert into top_scorer_candidates
